_source: Source: Meridian analysis, The Aviation Observatory; Sabre Global Demand Data; OAG schedules.

route_metadata._origin_city_need: airport code standing in; no IATA metro code in the payload
route_metadata._dest_city_need: airport code standing in; no IATA metro code in the payload

summary_and_schedule.catchment_note: Based on AviaSolutions' SJC Service Area catchment analysis
summary_and_schedule._schedule_times_need: departure time set by the caller

segment_forecast._rows_need: the eight-segment table needs: catchment tiers are available (catchment.tier_split over 260 locales and 11 airports within 220km, contested band 20 min, primary within 60 min) but no segment judgement inputs were given

point_to_point_total._basis: each way; base decomposed from the grown market at the payload's growth rate; capture is the effective rate after the capacity allocation, so the row multiplies through

connecting_at_hub_total._top_cities_need: the fifteen largest cities only, from cortex_app._feed_list(top=15); their sum is a subtotal and the leg total is stated separately

connecting_at_destination_total._top_cities_need: the fifteen largest cities only, from cortex_app._feed_list(top=15); their sum is a subtotal and the leg total is stated separately

grand_total._basis: carried, after the plan load factor cap; the legs below sum to it

segment_forecast._competition_basis: A market has direct competition where a nonstop already operates in the scheduled week (2026-05-25). The capture rates shown are MEASURED from the run, one rate per market applied by the engine and reported by bucket, not two rates assumed in advance.

cabin_load_factor._need: per-cabin LF needs a chosen LOPA + cabin demand (pass cabin=)

by_cabin._need: cabin revenue split needs a chosen LOPA + cabin demand (pass cabin=)

secondary.definition: Wider area where SJC competes on access time.

contested.definition: Outer overlap split by generalised cost.

zones._note: Zone geometry/population from the catchment module; the observed split is the apportionment.

airport.name: Norman Y Mineta San Jose International Airport

_settings.growth_basis: pre-COVID trend 2015-2019, 8.8%/yr on the two-way pair, tapered to a 3% long run: +18.3% over 2 yr from 2025
_settings.feed_level: Connecting level k = 1.0 (default); the back-tested level is 0.06.
